title: Works, but sometimes a hassle !
text:
Works, but sometimes a hassle !. This clingless shower curtain does work,
But I find it a pain in the neck to use on my liner with the outside balls knocking on the tub while trying to get the liner closed
to take a shower etc.!
I also think there should be 4 of the keepers in the package , not 3.
Since its being used on my guest bathroom tub shower liner. This is a problem for me!
Trying to keep the 3 keepers from not coming off the liner and then it gets pulled back after it dries with a fancy curtain on the outside, and pulled
back with a silk rope..
That is the reason for me to give it a 3 star.

product_metadata.title: Clingless Curtain Keeper, Round Champagne, Shower Curtain Liner Controller, Set of 3
features: Prevents your Shower Curtain/Liner from Blowing Inward and Touching you.
Works on ANY Bathtub and Shower Curtain / Liner.
Provides up to 25% More Shower Space.
Installs in Seconds with NO Tools Needed.
Compact Design makes it ideal for Travel and Gift Ideas.
description: Clingless Curtain Keeper pulls the shower curtain or shower liner away from you and towards the outside edge of the bathtub. The bottom of the shower curtain remains on the inside of the bathtub preventing water spills onto your floor. Additional benefits include: Solves Shower Curtain Cling… No more shower curtain touching you! Adds up to 25% More Shower Space! Designed to work with ANY shower curtain / shower liner and ANY bathtub! Comes Completely Assembled, so ZERO assembled required. No Tools Required! Just snap it on 12-15" above the bottom of the Shower Liner Healthier as it keeps a dirty shower liner from touching you. Better than shower curtain weights and magnets, but work well with existing. Accents your boring shower liner, visible with a single liner or can be hidden with a double curtain. Travels in any suitcase, so take it on the road to use at any hotel, resort or motel! Not limited to designs, shapes or colors because they are interchangeable. Easy Care: Wipe clean with sponge and soap!
